messages: elaine: Heads-up: all-hands begins in ~22m. Slight agenda tweak— were going to run the people updates first, then Q&A, then roadmap. Putting leadership Qs earlier to avoid overruns. anika: noted. can we bump the volunteer spotlight to the end? the speaker needs an extra 3m for their demo. ryan: ok to bump. tech note: rehearsal OBS saw a 6% frame drop on the main encoder, probably CPU-bound. please reduce source bitrate if youre streaming from laptops. karen: caption system shows degraded on one node. Ire cycling transcription-worker-3 now. ops-bot: Warning: transcription-worker-3 restarted (uptime 00:02). Live ingest OK. elaine: thanks karen. can someone confirm captions are live and the event doc has the Slido link? cameron: Slido link is updated in the doc. captions are live but words per minute lagging ~1.2s on my end. karen: lag is from the gpu-accelerated model warm-up. Ire switching to the low-latency pipeline: `/srv/captions/bin/lt-mode --model en-lite` should cut vtts to ~300ms. anika: any chance we can toggle alt audio for the host so post-call transcript is cleaner? ryan: yes, route host mic to track 2. config: `pulseaudio-monitor --route host:2` and recorder will capture separate track. cameron: I hit a permissions error when testing that last week: `PermissionError: /dev/snd/pcmC1D0p: access denied`. ops-bot: Permission change applied to group "streamops" for /dev/snd/* by automation (id: chgrp-2050). cameron: thanks. quick OBS fallback: if main scene freezes, switch to `scene: backup_static` and restart encoder: `pkill -f x264 && systemctl --user restart obs` then paste logs. elaine: leadership will take live Qs via Slido; flag anything sensitive to me. also DM me if you want a pre-brief. ryan: can we record a clean feed of the slide deck (no webcam) so we can repurpose the video? ops-bot: New capture: slide-clean-feed started (rec-id: sld-2050-1). Recording path: /mnt/rec/clean/slides/2050-03-23.mp4 elaine: disk space note: /mnt/rec currently 18% free after today's rehearsal. if any split occurs, auto-merge script is `/usr/local/bin/merge-recordings --src /mnt/rec/parts --dest /mnt/rec/final` (requires sudo). karen: merged rehearsal parts and validated checksums. no issues. anika: small ask for the Q&A: can we pin the top 5 Slido questions into the meeting doc so leadership doesn't get blind-sided? elaine: yes please pin 5. who can handle it live? cameron: I can curate live Qs during the meeting. ryan: mic check in 8m. i'll use headset as backup. cameron: headset test good, no echo. karen: caption worker on lt-mode. final check shows 310ms median latency. ops-bot: Live stream health: ingest 99.8% packet success, audio jitter 4ms. elaine: perfect. final reminder: close the meeting on time. post-call I'll post minutes and action items. thanks all!
